description: This is a PHP source file defining the 'Call' class in the Goteo project. It manages the 'Call' entity, which appears to represent a funding campaign or project call within the application. The class includes properties for detailed campaign data, constants for status IDs, database interactions (create, get, save, delete), validation, and business logic related to campaign states and relationships with other entities like projects, sponsors, banners, and users.

classes.name: Call
classes.description: Represents a campaign or funding call within the Goteo platform, managing campaign data, statuses, related entities, and business logic for campaign lifecycle management.

methods.name: getLangFields
methods.description: Returns array of language-specific fields for translation purposes.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new call record with provided name, owner, and optional error tracking.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a call record by its ID, including related user, categories, icons, projects, sponsors, banners, and status calculations.

methods.name: getMini
methods.description: Retrieves a minimal set of call data for display or overview without detailed related entities.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns a list of all calls with optional filtering (by status, caller, category, icon, etc.).

methods.name: getActive
methods.description: Returns active calls based on status and node configurations, suitable for listing on the platform.

methods.name: ofmine
methods.description: Returns calls owned by a specific user, optionally only published ones.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Provides a paginated list of calls with comprehensive filters, sorting, and count capabilities.

methods.name: getTranslates
methods.description: Lists calls available for translation based on filters like owner or translator.

methods.name: checkId
methods.description: Verifies and generates a unique ID for a call, appending suffixes if necessary.

methods.name: userIsOwner
methods.description: Checks if a user is owner or co-owner of the call, optionally verifying if in edition mode.

methods.name: userCanView
methods.description: Determines if a user has permission to view the call.

methods.name: userCanEdit
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission to edit or manage the call.

methods.name: getSupporters
methods.description: Returns supporters (investors) involved in this call, optionally counting only.

methods.name: getUsed
methods.description: Calculates and returns the committed capital for this call.

methods.name: getRest
methods.description: Calculates remaining funding capacity based on total amount and committed investments.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates call data fields for completeness and correctness.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists the call data and related entities to the database, handling uploads and relationships.

methods.name: ready
methods.description: Transitions the call to 'ready' status, typically after editing.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens the call for applications.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Re-enables the call for editing or management.

methods.name: publish
methods.description: Publishes the call, making projects available for contributions.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Marks the call as failed or cancelled.

methods.name: succeed
methods.description: Marks the call as successfully funded.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes the call and its related data, if in draft state.

methods.name: rebase
methods.description: Placeholder for reset or rebase logic, always returns false.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Performs data validation and scoring on the call fields.
